findings.title: Default-context path ignores ~/absolute relPaths
findings.detail: Context.getWorktreePath joins relPath as text. A default-context single repo with relPath ~/x or /abs/x produces a path that doesn't exist, so the IDE falls back to the parent. Pre-existing limitation, now used for IDE opening. Optional fix: use resolveAbsolutePath.

findings.title: openFirstExisting untested
findings.detail: The fallback chain (first existing wins, last candidate when none exist, no-op without an IDE command) has no test. Consider a hook test that mocks invoke.
